title: Morning Hub repair, roster preparation and source filing

dependency_checks: Resolve private references and verify exact school identity, tested capability, current authority and sole active owner before dependent work.
Acquire the shared browser/source lease including external sessions; a declared concurrency key or missing receipt is not proof that another writer is idle.
Read current authoritative sources and compare relevant revisions immediately before each mutation; stop that mutation on changed, partial or unavailable evidence.
Keep private records and raw evidence outside Git; a configured task, schema validation or open tab never establishes completed execution.
Source, content and assignment-binding mutations must finish before 07:00 America/New_York; hold remaining scope at cutoff and continue independent non-racing work.
IC is canonical. Complete membership evidence and a capability-verified synchronizer are required for roster writes; otherwise report status and preserve last complete roster.
Keep Study Hall roster-only. Remove verified departures from active operations while preserving originals, historical grades and private Former students copies.
Use one fresh batched overview with roster and Agenda bookends; never infer missing work or zeros from failed, changed, partial or rate-limited reads.
Unique fresh course/section/name evidence permits private filing only; grading still requires strict identity and exact assignment evidence.
Preserve original IDs, Form locations, answers, revisions, access, original dates and source links; use deployed archive and existing preview/apply/verify contracts.
Use exact current exclusions, shared-Form decisions and Photosynthesis repair-first scope; generic labels or filenames cannot select grading policy.
Read the current Hub repository START_HERE instructions before code repairs; use established release process and verify deployed behavior separately from local tests.

success_checks: Receipt distinguishes checked, filed, unchanged and held scope, actual cutoff completion, roster status, helper status and unresolved source coverage.
Every claimed repair has exact current source/destination revisions, saved identity/location/access and native readback; preview or copy alone is insufficient.
Existing Hub Today/checklist contains current evidence-backed state with teacher text preserved through revision-guarded readback.
